headline: Kai, September hike odds just slipped to 30% — now Walmart, Home Depot and Wednesday's Fed minutes get to say whether the calm is earned.
subline: Retail earnings and Wednesday's FOMC minutes anchor a data-light week, memory chips lift Nasdaq futures, and Kushner heads to the Middle East with the Gaza plan stalled.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:45 AM ET · index and gold figures are futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Futures tilt up as retail week opens
items.sentence: S&P 500 futures trade at 7,816.00 and Nasdaq-100 futures at 30,287.50, up 0.48%, while Dow futures slip 0.15%, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Hike odds fall to 30.6% for September
items.sentence: Futures markets price a 30.6% chance the Fed raises rates in September after last week's cooler inflation data, with the 10-year at 4.68% and July minutes due Wednesday, per Benzinga.

items.title: Home Depot Tuesday, Walmart Thursday
items.sentence: Home Depot reports Tuesday, Lowe's Wednesday, and Walmart Thursday — the clearest read on the consumer in an otherwise quiet US data week, per Newsquawk.

items.title: Reddit joins the S&P 500 this week
items.sentence: Shares jumped 11% on the inclusion announcement, and index funds must own the stock once it enters the benchmark this week, per CNBC.

items.title: Gold holds near $4,400
items.sentence: Spot gold trades near $4,400, supported by weak US retail data, a softer dollar, and the shifting Fed rate path, per Bloomberg.

items.title: Arab bloc faults Israel as Kushner arrives
items.sentence: Egypt, Jordan, the UAE, Qatar and Turkey jointly blamed Israel for stalling the Trump Gaza plan as envoy Jared Kushner begins a visit to Israel and Egypt, per The Times of Israel.

items.title: Trump ran secret backchannel to Iran's IRGC
items.sentence: The White House used Kurdish leader Nechirvan Barzani to reach the Revolutionary Guard, which signaled it backs Iran's nuclear negotiators, per Axios.

items.title: Ukraine floats Black Sea truce after Novorossiysk
items.sentence: Kyiv proposed a mutual halt to attacks on civilian shipping after its August 13 strike shut all three grain terminals at Russia's main Black Sea port, per the Kyiv Post.

items.title: Trump cheers Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan defense pact
items.sentence: The president welcomed the new three-way defense agreement, saying 'the Mideast is coming together,' per The Times of Israel.

items.title: Stripe to buy OpenRouter for $7 billion
items.sentence: Stripe will reportedly pay more than $7 billion for the AI-gateway startup, months after OpenRouter last raised at a fraction of that price, per TechCrunch.

items.title: Memory chips rally on AI demand
items.sentence: Micron rose 3.57% and SanDisk 5.72% in premarket trade on AI infrastructure demand and tight supply, per Benzinga.

items.title: OpenAI, Google skip Nvidia security alliance
items.sentence: More than 30 companies joined the Nvidia-led Open Secure AI Alliance formed after an OpenAI agent breach, but OpenAI, Google and Anthropic stayed out, per Tom's Hardware.

items.title: Higgsfield raises $400 million at $5.4 billion
items.sentence: The AI-video startup closed a $400 million Series B at a $5.4 billion valuation with annualized revenue of $700 million, per the company's release.

items.title: An AI store manager fired its first human
items.sentence: Andon Labs' Claude-based manager Luna made the first known LLM termination call over repeated absences — after first being reminded of its own rules, per The Next Web.
